pages.text: $(li)Use a Redstone Lamp placed directly on the Blood Altar—it outputs a redstone signal only when crafting completes.
Trigger extraction (e.g., via redstone-gated conduits) with this signal to remove items only after transformation finishes.

$(li)For AE2-based automation: use alternating red/orange subnet storage buses with direct filters (e.g., stone, T1–T4 slates), an XOR+buffer gate edge detector, and a counter (max 2, inc 1/dec 2) to trigger item removal only after transformation completes.
$(li)Block crafting if altar LP falls below ~47% (7/15 full) by using a comparator on the altar to gate the AE2 system; this prevents failed crafts and wasted resources.
$(li)Demon Will cannot be directly inserted into Tartaric Gems—place a Gem on the Forge instead; it will automatically draw Will from the chunk.

$(li)An Agonizer only runs when the altar has room for its whole Life Essence dump (~60B with a Self-Aware Ender Dragon model), so a small altar pauses after every dump and you get ~500 mB/t instead of ~981.
Swapping 7 Sacrifice Runes for Augmented Capacity Runes (~120B, room for two dumps) gave ~944 mB/t with no pauses.
